    Four Common Leaks

    Your website may be sending customers to your competitors

    01
    Expired cert · unreachable

    The browser flashes an "unsafe" warning

    Of the 33 businesses we audited, 5 had a site that wouldn't load or had an expired certificate — even a Michelin-recommended shop. Nine out of ten visitors close the tab the moment they see the warning.

    02
    Untouched for a decade

    A 2005-era design that's unusable on mobile

    Old desktop-only layout, menus and hours baked into images, "latest news" frozen since 2018. Over 60% of searches come from mobile — an old site is effectively invisible.

    03
    Facebook page only

    Facebook isn't your website

    A page's reach is decided by an algorithm, and Google can barely index its content. Your pricing, story, and ordering info all belong on a domain you actually own.

    04
    Others are taking your traffic

    Bloggers own your search results

    Customers search your name and first see someone else's food blog or a directory listing — often outdated. When they ask ChatGPT for a recommendation, it cites those pages too, not you.

    The two things we do

    Google can find you. AI will recommend you.

    SEO | Search Engine Optimization

    When customers Google "your trade + your area + recommended," your own site shows up — not a directory listing or someone's blog. How: a modern site structure, correct titles and descriptions, local business data, and ongoing content upkeep.

    Customer searches "Changhua gift recommendations" → your site shows up on page one
    AEO | AI Engine Optimization

    More customers now ask ChatGPT or Gemini directly. AI only cites pages it can understand and trust. How: FAQ content, structured data (Schema), and plain-text business info and pricing — so AI cites you in its answers.

    Customer asks AI "Any recommended office partition contractors in Taichung?" → AI cites your service page in its answer

    FAQ

    Questions owners ask us most

    Is the free website health check really free?

    Yes, no strings attached. After the check, we give you a plain-language report on where you stand and concrete recommendations — no pressure to buy or sign anything.

    Why is the price so much lower than the market rate?

    We use an AI-accelerated build process that compresses a project that used to take one or two months into 14 days (Quick Site) — the labor savings go straight into the price.

    What's the difference between SEO and AEO?

    SEO helps Google find your site; AEO gets AI search engines like ChatGPT and Gemini to cite your services in their answers. The techniques differ, and you need both.

    We don't have a website, only a Facebook page — is that OK?

    That's fine. A Facebook page's content can't be fully indexed by Google, so we recommend building a site on your own domain first — your page can keep running alongside it and cross-promote.

    Once the site is built, who owns the domain and hosting?

    Everything is handed over to you, including the domain, hosting account, and admin panel — the assets are entirely yours, and you're never locked in if you switch maintainers later.
